cmd-server-desc: Resource Map server tools: settings, set, speed, rescan, reload, stats
cmd-rescan-desc: Scan all loaded ground again for resources
cmd-stats-desc: Show how much has been scanned and found
rescan-started: Rescanning: {0} chunk column(s) queued. The map updates as they finish.
reloaded: Resource Map settings reloaded. Changed resource rules apply as ground is rescanned (use /resourcemap rescan to redo everything loaded).
stats: Scanned {0} chunk column(s), {1} with resources, {2} waiting, {3} scans this session. Cells found per resource:
cmd-client-desc: Resource Map: show the legend, or change how resources are drawn
cmd-opacity-desc: How solid clay and soil areas are, in percent (10-100)
cmd-markersize-desc: Size of the surface ore markers in pixels (4-40)
cmd-hide-desc: Hide a resource, e.g. .resourcemap hide soil-compost
cmd-color-desc: Change a resource colour, e.g. .resourcemap color clay-blue #3399ff (or 'default')
legend-title: Resource Map: {0} chunk column(s) with resources known. Map layers: Clay deposits, Peat & rich soil, Surface ores.
legend-help: Change with .resourcemap opacity / markersize / hide / show / color / reset. Search with .resourcemap find <resource>. See all with .resourcemap settings
not-allowed: On this server only admins can see the Resource Map.
opacity-set: Clay and soil areas now drawn at {0}%.
unknown-resource: No resource called '{0}' is known yet. Type .resourcemap to see the list.
now-hidden: {0} is now hidden on the map.
now-shown: {0} is shown on the map again.
bad-color: '{0}' isn't a colour. Use a hex colour like #3399ff, or 'default'.
cmd-settings-desc: List every server setting with its current value
cmd-set-desc: Change a server setting, e.g. /resourcemap set ScanDepth 4
cmd-speed-desc: Set how fast ground is scanned: slow, normal, fast or max
settings-title: Resource Map server settings (change with /resourcemap set <setting> <value>):
settings-help: Lists are comma separated, e.g. /resourcemap set SoilFertilities high, compost (use 'none' to empty). true/false also accept on/off.
set-usage: Use: /resourcemap set <setting> <value>. Type /resourcemap settings to see them all.
unknown-setting: There's no setting called '{0}'. Type /resourcemap settings to see them all.
need-bool: {0} needs true or false (on/off also work).
rescan-hint: This changes what is found: run /resourcemap rescan to redo ground already scanned.
speed-usage: Use: /resourcemap speed slow | normal | fast | max
speed-set: Scan speed set to {0}: {2} chunk column(s) every {1} ms (about {3} per second).
setting-ColumnsPerScan: chunk columns (32x32 blocks) scanned each time (1-32)
setting-SendIntervalMs: milliseconds between map updates sent to players (500-60000)
setting-MaxChunksPerPacket: chunk columns per update after joining (10-2000); joining players always get everything at once
setting-ScanDepth: blocks into the ground checked for clay, peat and soil (1-8)
setting-RescanAroundPlayersSeconds: seconds between rechecks of the ground around players (10-3600)
setting-RescanRadiusChunks: how many chunk columns around each player are rechecked (0-8)
setting-ShowSurfaceOres: show ore nuggets lying on the ground
setting-ShowExposedOres: show ore blocks on the surface and in cliff faces
setting-SoilFertilities: soil fertilities to show: verylow, low, medium, compost, high
setting-ExtraClayCodes: other mods' blocks to show as clay, by code start, e.g. mymod:clay-
setting-IgnoreCodes: blocks never to show, by code start, e.g. game:ore-flint
setting-AdminOnly: only admins can see the resource map
cmd-client-settings-desc: Show your own Resource Map settings
cmd-reset-desc: Put all your own Resource Map settings back to default
client-settings-help: Change with .resourcemap opacity <10-100> | markersize <4-40> | hide <resource> | show <resource> | color <resource> <#hex or default> | find <resource> | clear | reset
reset-done: Your Resource Map settings are back to default.
cmd-find-desc: Show only one resource and list the nearest, e.g. .resourcemap find malachite (add 'waypoint' to mark the nearest)
cmd-clear-desc: Stop searching and show every resource again
find-cleared: Search cleared: every resource is shown again.
find-none-known: Nothing called '{0}' has been found yet. Type .resourcemap to see what's known.
find-none-found: None of it is on the map at the moment.
